_comment: The UI test groups of ui.yml, one job each (read by .github/scripts/ui_groups.py, which also makes the job matrix).
only / skip: 'Class' or 'Class/testMethod' of AlbumistUITests, separated by spaces (-only-testing / -skip-testing).
device: pro (the image's iPhone Pro) or se (the small iPhone), see .github/toolchain.json.
flow-other is 'everything the other groups do not run', so a new test class always runs somewhere and no test runs twice
(test_ui_tests.py GroupTests checks every UI test against the groups). Keep its skip list in step with the others.

The order is the start order: the longest in a full run (device-flows, device, flow-other) start first, accessibility (the longest of the short ones) fourth. max-parallel 5 in ui.yml holds back the last group (contrast) until one ends; while CI's macOS job still runs, GitHub's account queue (five Macs) holds one more of the started groups, whichever it picks. In a TestFlight run (max-parallel 3) the three long ones run first and the three short ones follow.
A change here changes the test fingerprint of the group that changed (ui_groups.py), so that group runs again.
budget_min: minutes for the group's test passes (ui_tests.py budget_check); over it the run shows a warning, never red. Report-only, so not in the fingerprint.
Measured in TestFlight run 44461253154 (19.11.): device 62, flow-full 12, flow-other 52, accessibility 20, contrast 15 min (the step Run UI tests).

Rebalanced 20.11. (tempo plan): DeviceConditionUITests 05, 07, 08 left other flows and 11 left device conditions for the new group device-flows; quick runs measured before: other flows 55.8, device 43.3 min (job, median since 18.11.).

Rebalanced 21.11. by the full UI run 44828248004 (test minutes): other flows 47.2, device-flows 36.3, accessibility 22.8, device 21.0, contrast 9.3, flow-full 8.7. AlbumistFlowUITests/test1b (11.6) left other flows for flow-full: other flows about 36, flow-full about 20. The small gate (flow-full and contrast) grows by those 11.6 minutes.

groups.title: undo, interrupted plans and large library
groups._why: DeviceConditionUITests 05, 07, 08 (undo when iOS declines, interrupted plan, removed album; before 20.11. in other flows) and 11 (large library, about 25 min, skips itself in quick mode; before 20.11. in device conditions) on the Pro simulator. Split off so that no group runs much longer than the others (tempo plan 20.11., measured in UI run 44617747359: other flows 55.8 min job, device 43.3, these four tests 17 min quick and about 42 min full).

groups.title: device conditions
groups._why: The device-condition switches (App/Albumist/Platform/UITestSwitches.swift) on the Pro simulator. A test that resets the photo access asks the Mac to give it back (UI_HOST_GRANT_PHOTOS, answered by ui_tests.py). DeviceConditionUITests 05, 07, 08 and 11 run in the group device-flows (tempo plan 20.11.: the longest group sets the run's time); test12 is the stress test and skips itself here (ui-stress.yml).

groups.title: other flows, purchase and search
groups._why: Every other UI test except the accessibility tests (flow tests 1b-7, locked purchase, search). Each brings the app to an onboarded demo library by itself (UITestOnboarding).

groups.title: accessibility (small iPhone)
groups._why: AccessibilityUITests 1-4 on a small iPhone (SE, 375 pt) with Reduce Motion. These tests fail on findings.

groups.title: full flow, video, atlas and library
groups._why: Onboarding, demo library, plan and the sorting-show video (test1), then atlas, library and search on the library test1 made (test1b, 11.6 min; it ran after test1 in one group before 16.11.). test1b moved here from other flows on 21.11.: in the full UI run 44828248004 other flows took 47.2 test minutes, the most of any group, this group 8.7. PerformanceUITests (21.11., report only: start, scrolling, and in full runs the analysis, about 8 min) run last here, on the library test1 made.

groups.title: contrast (small iPhone)
groups._why: AccessibilityUITests test5 on its own small iPhone with Reduce Motion, Increase Contrast and Reduce Transparency switched on before the first launch; the test onboards by itself (onboardAndSeed). Its own job since 16.11. (UI run 43906501407).
